records.query: Tell me about Falcon Arm v3.
records.expected_behavior: overview of Falcon v3

response.answer: Falcon Arm v3 is Northwind Robotics' third-generation collaborative robotic arm, targeting small-to-mid-size manufacturing and warehouse automation. It improves on Falcon v2 with a 12 kg payload capacity (vs. 8 kg), 1.3 m reach (vs. 1.1 m), ±0.03 mm repeatability (vs. ±0.05 mm), and reduced unit cost ($8,200 target, $8,600 actual). It includes safety features like force-limiting collision detection, a physical e-stop button, and ISO/TS 15066 certification. The launch was delayed to Q4 2024 due to field-testing time, with OTA firmware updates staged over 72 hours. A servo motor shortage risk was resolved via a second supplier (Denwa Motors).
